flagged.title: Decorative Arts & Material Culture
flagged.reason: The video repeats outdated and incorrect descriptions for four prescribed GCSE Mycenaean artefacts (the Lion Hunt Dagger, the gold rhyton, the gold pyxis, and the Warrior Vase), which would cost students marks in visual source questions.

mark_affecting.quote: It depicts lions in full flight chasing spotted deer while human hunters advance with spears and these massive tower shields.
The gold one from Grave Circle A is hammered from a thin sheet of gold. But what actually makes it special is what's missing: it is completely undecorated.
A pyxis is essentially a small round box with a fitted lid... This particular pyxis is hammered from solid gold sheet and decorated entirely with those running spirals
it shows two rows of marching soldiers facing each other.
